blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This work presents a compact and reproducible pipeline for synthesizing and curating image-based instruction-response pairs for DCVLR. We draw from the Cauldron collection and use Magpie-style instruction and response synthesis with Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct to create concise, image-conditioned instruction pairs. The pipeline consists of instruction synthesis, conditioned on input images and controlled via a system prompt, sanitization, tagging, and filtering of the instructions based on the score obtained by a reward model (DeBERTa-v3). We retain samples with positive scores to maximize the quality of the generated instructions. We observe that score distributions have a median and mean reward score of ~ 1.53 and ~ 1.75 respectively, indicating that most generated instructions are of good quality. The resulting dataset contains diverse instructions in the math, spatial, and social reasoning domains.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为DCVLR合成和处理基于图像的指令-响应对提供了紧凑和可复制的管道。 我们从Cauldron集合中抽取,使用Magpie风格的指令和反应合成,使用Quen2.5-VL-7B 指令来创建简洁,图像化的指令对. 管道由指令合成组成,以输入图像为条件,并通过系统即时,消毒,标记,以及根据奖励模型(DeBERTa-v3)获得的分数过滤指令进行控制. 我们保留有正分数的样本,以最大限度地提高生成指令的质量。 我们注意到,分数分配的中位数和中位数奖励分数分别为~1.53和~1.75,表明大多数生成的指令质量良好. 由此产生的数据集包含数学、空间和社会推理领域的各种指示。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal systems increasingly rely on image-grounded instruction–response data to elicit robust visual reasoning. However, existing resources often prioritize scale over coverage, cleanliness, and reproducibility , which are equally critical for the DCVLR competition. We ask: Can we build a compact, high-quality, and fully traceable image–instruction corpus that reliably triggers visual reasoning without sacrificing efficiency?
blocks.zh: 多式联运系统越来越依赖基于图像的指令-反应数据,以引出强有力的视觉推理。 然而,现有资源往往将规模置于覆盖、清洁和再生产之上,这对DCVLR的竞争同样至关重要。 我们问:我们能否建立一个紧凑、高质量和完全可追踪的图像 — — 在不牺牲效率的情况下可靠地触发视觉推理的工具?

blocks.en: Here, we present a single-pass, compute-efficient pipeline that synthesizes concise, vision-aware instructions and high-fidelity responses with explicit traceability and tunable quality control.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们提出一个单一的、具有计算效率的管道,它综合了简明、有远见的指示和高可靠性的对策,具有明确的可追踪性和可捕性质量控制。

blocks.en: Our approach adapts recent synthesis pipelines (i.e., Magpie Xu et al. () ) to vision–language models (VLMs). Starting from the Cauldron collection Laurençon et al. (2024) , we condition the Magpie synthesis pipeline on the images to generate instructions and corresponding answers using Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025) under input formatting and sanitization. The instructions are then tagged, and scored using a reward model to keep only instructions with high reward scores, as a quality control step.
blocks.zh: 我们的办法使最近的合成管道(即Magpie Xu等人())适应视觉语言模型(VLMs)。 从Cauldron收集Laurençon等人(2024年)开始,我们把Magpie合成管固定在图像上,使用Qune2.5-VL-7B-Instruct Bai等生成指令和相应的答案. (2025) 在输入格式化和消毒下. 指示随后被贴上标签,并使用奖励模式打分,只保留奖励分高的指令,作为质量控制步骤.

blocks.en: Concretely, the pipeline proceeds through five stages: (1) loading and optional subsampling; (2) instruction synthesis; (3) response generation with vision-aware decoding; (4) instruction sanitization; and (5) reward-model scoring. For multi-image conditioning, we introduce a Magpie-inspired formatting strategy that packs vision tokens to yield concise, grounded interactions without bloated context.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,管道经过了五个阶段:(1) 装载和可选分样;(2) 指令合成;(3) 具有视觉感知解码的反应生成;(4) 指令消毒;和(5) 奖励模式分数。 对于多图像调制,我们引入了由Magpie启发的格式化策略,将视觉符号打包起来,产生简洁而有根基的互动,而不会膨胀上下文.

blocks.en: Contributions.
blocks.zh: 捐款。

blocks.en: • Magpie-style pipeline: We use a system prompt and an image-only pre-query; the model first synthesizes the user instruction from the image, then generates the paired assistant response—yielding grounded instruction–response pairs. • Vision-aware formatting for multi-image inputs. A Magpie-inspired scheme for conditioning on multiple images (via vision tokens) that preserves grounding while keeping interactions concise. • Automated, tunable quality control. A reward-model scoring stage with a tunable threshold t t . Stricter thresholds lead to higher rejection rates, but increase the final instruction quality

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Template-Driven Instruction Synthesis. Aligned language models can self-synthesize instructions when prompted with the left context of a chat template, eliminating seed questions and heavy prompt engineering. Magpie Xu et al. () formalizes this idea and scales instruction creation with simple formatting and cleaning. Earlier works, i.e., Self-Instruct Wang et al. (2023) , Alpaca Dubois et al. (2023) , and Evol-Instruct/WizardLM Xu et al. (2024) have more limited scalability and diversity, regarding the number of synthesized instructions. We adapt Magpie’s self-synthesis to the VLM setting while enforcing strict formatting and sanitization.
blocks.zh: 模板驱动指令综合. 相通语言模型在用聊天模板的左上下文被提示时可以自合成指令,去除种子问题和重快工程. 玛格比 徐等 ()以简单的格式化和清扫方式,将这种思想和规模化的指令创建正式化. 更早的作品,即自导自演的"王等"(2023),"阿尔帕卡·杜波依斯等"(2023)和"Evol-Instruct/WizardLM·许等"(2024)在合成指令数量方面的可伸缩性和多样性较为有限. 我们让Magpie的自我合成适应VLM设置,

blocks.en:
Vision–Language Instruction Tuning and Formatting. Modern VLMs adopt concise, chat-oriented interfaces and lightweight post-training. Modern VLM examples tuned on visual instructions include LLaVA Liu et al. (2023) , InstructBLIP Dai et al. (2023) , MiniGPT-4 Zhu et al. () .
These systems exhibit visual reasoning capabilities and excellent multi-task performance, highlighting the benefits of multi-image conditioning, text-rich inputs, and instruction diversity.
blocks.zh:
Vision–语言指导 训导和格式化. 现代VLM采用简洁,以聊天为导向的界面和轻量级后期训练. 以视觉指示为调取的现代VLM实例包括LLaVA Liu等人(2023年),InstructBLIP Dai等人(2023年),MiniGPT-4 Zhu等. (编).
这些系统展现出视觉推理能力和出色的多任务性能,突出了多图像调制,文本丰富的输入,以及指令多样性的优点.

blocks.en: Reward Models and Post-Hoc Filtering. Quality control in alignment often relies on reward models to filter or weigh data before training Ouyang et al. (2022) ; Bai et al. (2022) . We use a reward model based on DeBERTa-v3 He et al. () for instruction scoring which provides good performance and low latency. Thresholding the scores yields a simple, reproducible keep/cut rule.
blocks.zh: 奖励模型和后热滤镜. 校正中的质量控制往往依靠奖励模型在训练欧阳等人(2022年); Bai等人(2022年)之前过滤或权衡数据. 我们使用基于DeBERTa-v3 He等人()的奖励模式进行教学评分,该评分表现良好,且不成熟。 扣分产生一个简单,可复制的保存/剪接规则.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: The proposed pipeline for data synthesis and curation based on Magpie.
blocks.zh: 图 1:基于Magpie的数据合成和校正的拟议管道.

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 shows the proposed multimodal instruction synthesis pipeline.
We adopt a Magpie-style pipeline that turns images into concise, grounded prompt-response-image triplets, with lightweight cleaning and a reward-based filter. Concretely, we use an image-only pre-query; the model first autoregressively synthesizes the user instruction based on the image, and then, after inserting the assistant header, generates the paired assistant response. We apply light sanitization (token/whitespace normalization, template validation), rule-based guards for modality grounding, i.e., the instruction must reference visible content, and near-duplicate removal.
Each example is conditioned by the image and a short system prompt that specifies the task family, e.g., “ask about spatial arrangement". We use a compact chat format system turn followed by a user turn that carries vision tokens, so the model is primed to emit an instruction directly from visual context (self-synthesis).
blocks.zh:
图1显示了拟议的多式联运指令合成管道。
我们采用一种Maggie式的管道,把图像变成简洁、有底线的即时反应图像三胞胎,并进行轻量级清洁和基于奖励的过滤。 具体来说,我们使用只用图像的预压;模型首先根据图像自动合成用户指令,然后在插入助理头后生成配对的助理响应. 我们采用光消毒(token/whitespace normality,模板验证),基于规则的守护模式地平地,即指令必须参考可见的内容,以及近似重复去除.
每个例子都以图像和一个简短的系统提示为条件,该提示规定了任务系列,例如“关于空间安排的任务”。 我们使用紧凑的聊天格式系统,然后是带视觉符号的用户转动,所以模型被定型从视觉上下文(自合成)直接发出指令.

blocks.en:
The model produces a candidate instruction conditioned on the image. A sanitization pass removes boilerplate, control markers, and residual formatting, yielding a minimal, model-ready prompt.
Given the cleaned instruction and the same image context, the model generates a response. A second sanitizationr pass standardizes punctuation and trims generation artifacts. We then perform tagging, e.g., difficulty labels, for downstream analysis.
blocks.zh:
该模型生成一个以图像为条件的候选指令. 消毒通关可去除锅炉板,控制标记,并进行残留格式化,产生出最小的,模型准备的快取.
考虑到被清理的指令和相同的图像上下文,模型生成一个响应. 第二道消毒器通过规范了活泼和修剪出产文物. 然后我们进行标记,例如难度标记,用于下游分析。

blocks.en: All instruction–response pairs pass through a reward model that assigns a scalar score. A simple threshold selects retained items (higher scores) and discards low-quality pairs, enabling stricter or looser quality control. An optional reasoning check can be applied before final acceptance, followed by a brief final sanitization to ensure formatting consistency.
blocks.zh: 所有指令 - 答对通过一个奖励模式,该模式分配了分数. 一个简单的阈值会选择被保留的项目(得分较高)并丢弃低质量的对子,从而能够进行更严格或更松的质量控制. 在最后验收之前可以进行可选推理检查,然后进行简短的最后消毒以确保格式一致性.

blocks.en: The outputs of this pipeline are compact, cleaned instructions, responses, and tags, together with reward scores. These artifacts are ready for post-hoc filtering, analysis, and integration into instruction-tuning or evaluation workflows.
blocks.zh: 这一管道的产出是紧凑的、清洁的指令、答复和标签以及奖励分数。 这些文物已准备就绪,可进行热后过滤,分析,并融入指令调试或评价工作流程.

blocks.en: 4 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4 执行细节

blocks.en:
For instruction and response synthesis we use Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct . Images are sampled from the Cauldron collection, a unified collection of ∼ 50 \sim 50 vision–language training sets released with Idefics2 Laurençon et al. (2024) . Cauldron aggregates multi-domain tasks (VQA, OCR/docs, charts/tables, math/logic, multi-image, screenshots) and is widely reused for instruction tuning. We sample 5000 5000 images from each subset and generate instructions based on the sampled images. The reward model used for scoring is OpenAssistant/reward-model-deberta-v3-large-v2 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/OpenAssistant/reward-model-deberta-v3-large-v2 .
We set the selection threshold to t = 0 t=0 , keeping samples with positive scores, and then select the top 10000 10000 samples among those. All experiments are run on nodes from the Leonardo-Booster supercomputer. Each node contains 4 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 64GB VRAM.
blocks.zh:
在指令和反应合成方面,我们使用Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct。 图片取自Cauldron收藏, Cauldron聚合多域任务(VQA,OCR/docs,图表/表,数学/逻辑,多图像,截图),被广泛再用来进行指令调试. 我们从每个子集中抽取了50005000个图像,并根据所抽取的图像生成指示. 评分使用的奖励模式为: Open Apoint/reward-model-deberta-v3-great-v2 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/Open Apoint/reward-model-deberta-v3-great-v2 。 。 。 。
我们把选取阈值设定为t=0t=0,保留有正分分分的样本,然后从中选择前10000分10000分样本. 所有实验都运行在列奥纳多-博斯特超级计算机的节点上. 每个节点包含4个4个NVIDIA A100 GPU并有64GB VRAM.

blocks.en: 4.1 System Prompts
blocks.zh: 4.1 系统提示

blocks.en: System prompts are organized into categories to steer generation for different capabilities. We maintain targeted categories for text extraction , spatial relations , and mathematics/quantitative reasoning, alongside a general category that applies across most subsets as seen in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 系统提示被组织成类别来引导生成不同能力. 我们保留了文本提取、空间关系和数学/定量推理的目标类别,同时保留了一个适用于附录A所示大多数子集的一般类别。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: In this work we extend Magpie to generate visual instructions grounded on input images. Instruction synthesis is guided by system prompts and the quality of the resulting samples is automatically determined through reward model scores. In our implementation we have observed that proper sanitization of the generated instructions and the inclusion of system prompts for conditioning is paramount, since VLMs are biased towards producing captions and descriptions of the input images without further guidance.
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们扩展了"Magpie"以生成基于输入图像的视觉指令. 指令合成以系统提示为指针,产生的样品的质量通过奖励模型分数自动确定. 在执行过程中,我们观察到,对生成的指令进行适当消毒并纳入系统促动调节至关重要,因为VLM偏向于制作输入图像的字幕和描述而无需提供进一步指导。

blocks.en: In the future we plan to extend this pipeline to generate more diverse visual instruction sets, through the inclusion of more system prompts and diverse input images. Furthermore, we plan to run detailed ablations to guide our decisions on reward model, threshold and system prompt selection.
blocks.zh: 今后,我们计划扩大这一管道,通过纳入更多的系统提示和不同的输入图像,产生更加多样化的视觉指示集。 此外,我们计划详细安排,指导我们关于奖励模式、门槛和制度迅速甄选的决定。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our work is still at the proof of concept stage and has several limitations. First, due to time constraints ablation studies were not systematically performed. The model used for synthesis is a relatively small (7 billion) parameter LLM, limiting the quality and diversity of the synthesized visual instructions. Finally, stratification of the selected samples during reward scoring and inclusion of more system prompts may be included to ensure higher diversity of the final dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作仍处于概念阶段,并有一些局限性。 首先,由于时间限制,没有系统地开展消瘦研究。 用于合成的模型是一个相对较小的(70亿)参数LLM,限制了被合成的视觉指令的质量和多样性. 最后,在奖励评分期间对选定的样本进行分层,并纳入更多的系统提示,以确保最后数据集更加多样化。

blocks.en: Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 更大的影响

blocks.en: Our work on synthetic data generation has broad societal implications, offering substantial benefits while also posing serious risks. On the positive side, this technology can significantly accelerate machine learning research, since scalable data synthesis pipelines are an economically viable way to obtain data, especially for areas and problems where data are relatively scarce. Furthermore, synthetic data offer pathways for more private and fair models, since inherent biases can be balanced out and personal identifying information that exists in real datasets is not included. However, these capabilities are shadowed by the potential for malicious use, particularly in the generation of sophisticated disinformation and deepfakes. Furthermore, improperly trained models risk amplifying the societal biases they are intended to correct. Progress in this domain must be tightly coupled with a commitment to developing detection techniques, fairness audits, and clear ethical guidelines. Finally, there is an ongoing discussion about the decline in diversity of LLM outputs due the self-consuming training loops in the research community, and synthetic data contribute to this issue. Further investigation should be performed about the limits of this approach.
blocks.zh: 我们关于合成数据生成的工作具有广泛的社会影响,既带来巨大利益,又造成严重风险。 在积极的一面,这种技术可以大大地加速机器学习研究,因为可扩展的数据合成管道是获取数据的一种经济上可行的方法,对于数据相对稀少的地区和问题尤其如此. 此外,合成数据为更私人和公平的模型提供了途径,因为内在偏见是可以平衡的,而实际数据集中存在的个人识别信息则不包括在内。 然而,这些能力被恶意使用的可能性所掩盖,特别是在制造尖端的假象和深层假象方面。 此外,训练有素的模型有可能扩大它们打算纠正的社会偏见。 在这一领域取得进展的同时,必须致力于开发检测技术、进行公平审计并制订明确的道德准则。 最后,人们正在讨论由于研究界自费的培训循环,LLM产出的多样性正在下降,而合成数据也助长了这一问题。 应就这种做法的局限性作进一步调查。
